label: 2. Eventos e simulação
info: Eventos normalizados pelo Pentaho (tabela event) e formulário para simular um evento de sensor. O evento simulado entra na fila do gateway REST e só é processado na execução seguinte do ETL.

name: KPIs fontes
KPIs
Contagens por fonte
query:
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE source = 'ACCESS') AS acc,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE source = 'SENSOR' AND event_id NOT LIKE 'SIM%') AS sen,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_id LIKE 'SIM%') AS sim,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM dq_rejection WHERE run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM etl_run ORDER BY requested_at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS rej
FROM event;

name: Eventos recentes
query:
SELECT event_id AS "ID", to_char(event_ts, 'DD/MM HH24:MI:SS') AS "Hora", source AS "Fonte",
       event_type AS "Tipo", zone_id AS "Zona", coalesce(user_id, '—') AS "Utilizador",
       CASE WHEN is_off_hours THEN 'sim' ELSE '' END AS "Fora de horas",
       CASE WHEN is_unauthorized_zone THEN 'sim' ELSE '' END AS "Sem permissão"
FROM event ORDER BY event_ts DESC, event_id DESC LIMIT 200;

name: Eventos por hora
query:
SELECT lpad(extract(hour FROM event_ts)::int::text, 2, '0') || 'h' AS x, source AS series, count(*)::int AS n
FROM event GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2;

label: 3. Incidentes
info: Casos correlacionados marcados como suspeitos pelas regras e/ou pela IA. Ao selecionar um incidente mostram-se o resultado das duas abordagens, a explicação do Qwen3 e os eventos de origem.

name: Selecionar um incidente → detalhe e evidências (rastreabilidade)
Detalhe do caso
Detalhe do caso
query:
SELECT c.case_id, z.name AS zone_name, z.security_level, r.is_suspicious AS rules_suspicious,
       r.risk_level AS rules_risk, r.matched_rules, a.status AS ai_status, a.is_suspicious AS ai_suspicious,
       a.risk_level AS ai_risk, a.incident_type, a.explanation, a.recommended_action, a.evidence_event_ids,
       a.model_name, a.model_digest, a.latency_ms
FROM security_case c
JOIN zone z USING (zone_id)
JOIN rule_result r USING (case_id)
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM ai_analysis x WHERE x.events_hash = c.events_hash
                   ORDER BY (x.status = 'OK') DESC, x.analyzed_at DESC LIMIT 1) a ON true
WHERE c.case_id = $1;

name: Eventos do caso
query:
SELECT e.event_id AS "Evento", to_char(e.event_ts, 'HH24:MI:SS') AS "Hora", e.event_type AS "Tipo",
       coalesce(e.device_id, '') AS "Dispositivo", coalesce(e.user_id, '—') AS "Utilizador",
       CASE WHEN position(e.event_id IN coalesce(a.evidence_event_ids, '')) > 0 THEN '★ IA' ELSE '' END AS "Evidência"
FROM case_event ce JOIN event e USING (event_id) JOIN security_case c USING (case_id)
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT evidence_event_ids FROM ai_analysis x WHERE x.events_hash = c.events_hash AND x.status = 'OK'
                   ORDER BY x.analyzed_at DESC LIMIT 1) a ON true
WHERE ce.case_id = $1 ORDER BY e.event_ts, e.event_id;

name: Incidentes
query:
SELECT c.case_id AS "Caso", z.name AS "Zona", to_char(c.start_ts, 'DD/MM HH24:MI') AS "Início",
       c.event_count AS "Eventos",
       CASE WHEN r.is_suspicious THEN r.risk_level || ' (' || r.matched_rules || ')' ELSE '—' END AS "Regras",
       CASE WHEN a.status = 'OK' AND a.is_suspicious THEN a.risk_level || ' · ' || a.incident_type
            WHEN a.status = 'OK' THEN 'não suspeito' WHEN a.status IS NULL THEN 'não enviado' ELSE a.status END AS "IA",
       CASE WHEN r.is_suspicious AND coalesce(a.is_suspicious, false) THEN 'Ambos'
            WHEN r.is_suspicious THEN 'Só regras' ELSE 'Só IA' END AS "Detetado por"
FROM security_case c
JOIN zone z USING (zone_id)
JOIN rule_result r USING (case_id)
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM ai_analysis x WHERE x.events_hash = c.events_hash
                   ORDER BY (x.status = 'OK') DESC, x.analyzed_at DESC LIMIT 1) a ON true
WHERE r.is_suspicious OR (a.status = 'OK' AND a.is_suspicious)
ORDER BY c.start_ts;

label: 4. Estatísticas
info: Indicadores de processamento e incidentes e comparação das métricas de avaliação (evaluation_metric, calculadas pelo Pentaho em tr_evaluate).

name: KPIs
KPIs
Resumo
query:
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM event) AS events, (SELECT count(*) FROM security_case) AS cases,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM rule_result WHERE is_suspicious) AS inc_rules,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT a.case_id) FROM ai_analysis a JOIN security_case c ON c.events_hash = a.events_hash
         WHERE a.status = 'OK' AND a.is_suspicious) AS inc_ai,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM ai_analysis WHERE status = 'OK') AS ai_ok,
       (SELECT round(avg(latency_ms) / 1000.0, 1) FROM ai_analysis WHERE status = 'OK' AND latency_ms > 0) AS ai_lat;

name: Por risco
query:
SELECT risk_level AS x, 'Regras' AS series, count(*)::int AS n FROM rule_result WHERE is_suspicious GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT risk_level, 'IA', count(*)::int FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.case_id) c.case_id, c.zone_id, a.risk_level, a.is_suspicious
  FROM security_case c JOIN ai_analysis a ON a.events_hash = c.events_hash AND a.status = 'OK'
  ORDER BY c.case_id, a.analyzed_at DESC) ai WHERE is_suspicious GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

name: Por zona
query:
SELECT c.zone_id AS x, 'Regras' AS series, count(*)::int AS n
FROM security_case c JOIN rule_result r USING (case_id) WHERE r.is_suspicious GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT zone_id, 'IA', count(*)::int FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.case_id) c.case_id, c.zone_id, a.risk_level, a.is_suspicious
  FROM security_case c JOIN ai_analysis a ON a.events_hash = c.events_hash AND a.status = 'OK'
  ORDER BY c.case_id, a.analyzed_at DESC) ai WHERE is_suspicious GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

name: Métricas da última avaliação
query:
SELECT CASE approach WHEN 'RULES' THEN 'A — Regras (82 casos)' WHEN 'AI' THEN 'B — IA híbrida (82 casos)'
            WHEN 'RULES_AI_SUBSET' THEN 'A — Regras (subconjunto IA)' ELSE 'B — IA (subconjunto IA)' END AS "Abordagem",
       n_cases AS "Casos", tp AS "TP", fp AS "FP", tn AS "TN", fn AS "FN", n_failed AS "Falhas",
       precision_val AS "Precisão", recall_val AS "Recall", f1_val AS "F1",
       round(avg_latency_ms / 1000.0, 1) AS "Latência média (s)"
FROM evaluation_metric WHERE run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM evaluation_metric ORDER BY computed_at DESC LIMIT 1)
ORDER BY approach;

label: 5. Logs e erros
info: Execuções (etl_run), erros classificados por componente (ETL Pentaho, API FastAPI, modelo Qwen3, notificação SMTP) e rejeições de qualidade de dados (dq_rejection).

name: Execuções
query:
SELECT run_id AS "Execução", trigger_source AS "Origem", status AS "Estado",
       to_char(started_at, 'DD/MM HH24:MI:SS') AS "Início", to_char(finished_at - started_at, 'MI:SS') AS "Duração",
       coalesce(exit_code::text, '') AS "Exit code", coalesce(error_message, '') AS "Erro"
FROM etl_run ORDER BY requested_at DESC LIMIT 30;

name: Erros por componente
query:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT 'ETL (Pentaho)' AS "Componente", s.stage || ': ' || coalesce(s.message, '') AS "Detalhe",
         to_char(s.finished_at, 'DD/MM HH24:MI') AS "Quando", s.run_id AS "Execução"
  FROM etl_run_stage s WHERE s.status = 'FAILED' AND s.stage <> 'NOTIFY'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Notificação (SMTP)', s.message, to_char(s.finished_at, 'DD/MM HH24:MI'), s.run_id
  FROM etl_run_stage s WHERE s.stage = 'NOTIFY' AND s.status = 'FAILED'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'API (FastAPI)', a.status || ': ' || left(coalesce(a.error_message, ''), 120), to_char(a.analyzed_at, 'DD/MM HH24:MI'), a.run_id
  FROM ai_analysis a WHERE a.status IN ('API_UNAVAILABLE', 'MODEL_ERROR', 'INVALID_INPUT')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Modelo (Qwen3)', a.status || ': ' || left(coalesce(a.error_message, ''), 120), to_char(a.analyzed_at, 'DD/MM HH24:MI'), a.run_id
  FROM ai_analysis a WHERE a.status IN ('TIMEOUT', 'INVALID_OUTPUT')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'IA ignorada', s.stage || ': ' || coalesce(s.message, ''), to_char(s.finished_at, 'DD/MM HH24:MI'), s.run_id
  FROM etl_run_stage s WHERE s.stage = 'AI' AND s.status = 'SKIPPED'
) e ORDER BY "Quando" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50;

name: Rejeições
